The levels that matter

  • Right now: sitting on the 38.2% of the rebound ($353.73). Friday's low was $349.33.
  • Support below: $343–345 (50% of the rebound + 23.6% of the decline — a cluster), then $332.
  • Resistance: $370–374 (20-day + 38.2% of the decline), then $388 (200-day + Oct 9 high).
  • Read: the rebound stalled under the 200-day. Until TSLA closes above ~$388, the bigger trend is down.

Earnings: Tuesday, Oct 21, 2026 (EPS est. ~$0.26). Expect big moves and expensive options going in, and a drop in option prices right after (IV crush).
